description: Discretization, net-delta risk, rules, and live-gate rejection reasons.

options.content:
**Source:** `ControllerDiagnostics` rejection counts and execution gate reasons.

**Discretization:** local curve → ladder → capped.
**Target-book risk:** frame gates (stale data, warmup) and net-delta collateral limits.
**Rules gateway:** tick size, min qty, min notional.
**Live gates:** observe-only, venue paused, stale global market, etc.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time",
  kv.key AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','capped','rejection_counts'], '{}'::jsonb)
) AS kv
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time",
  kv.key AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','rejection_counts'], e.payload->'risk'->'rejection_counts'), '{}'::jsonb)
) AS kv
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time",
  kv.key AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','rules_valid','rejection_counts'], '{}'::jsonb)
) AS kv
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", reason AS metric, 1::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
  COALESCE(e.payload->'execution_gates'->'blocked_reasons', '[]'::jsonb)
) AS reason
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT gate.key AS exchange,
  COALESCE(gate.value->>'role', '') AS role,
  COALESCE(gate.value->>'live', '') AS live,
  COALESCE(gate.value->'blocked_reasons', '[]'::jsonb)::text AS blocked_reasons
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload->'execution_gates'->'venue_gates', '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 20

list.definition:
SELECT actor_id
FROM (
  SELECT actor_id, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT actor_id, updated_at AS latest_ts
  FROM registry_strategies
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND actor_id IS NOT NULL
    AND actor_id <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE actor_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(actor_id AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY actor_id
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
